body.name: Adjacent-intensity efficiency-gain diagnostic
body.construction: For each \(c_j\in\mathcal C_{\mathrm{adj}}\), form the recovered cell vector \(v_j\), apply the measurement-form projector \(N_B=I_{K^{2}}-D^{-1}B(B^{\mathsf T}D^{-1}B)^{+}B^{\mathsf T}\), augment \(G(X)\) to \(G_j^{\mathrm{aug}}(X)=\begin{pmatrix}G(X)&b_{v_j}(X)\\b_{v_j}(X)^{\mathsf T}&E_P\{[N_Bv_j](O)^2\mid X\}\end{pmatrix}\), and take its Schur residual \(\Lambda_j(X)=E_P\{[N_Bv_j](O)^2\mid X\}-b_{v_j}(X)^{\mathsf T}G(X)^{+}b_{v_j}(X)\)
